clem: dixit ad eos: Audite sermones meos: si quis fuerit inter vos propheta Domini, in visione apparebo ei, vel per somnium loquar ad illum.
kjv: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the Lord will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.

wlc: לֹא־כֵן עַבְדִּי מֹשֶׁה בְּכָל־בֵּיתִי נֶאֱמָן הוּא ׃
lxx: οὐχ οὕτως ὁ θεράπων μου Μωυσῆς· ἐν ὅλῳ τ πιστός ἐστιν·
vulg: at non talis servus meus Moses qui in omni domo mea fidelissimus est
clem: At non talis servus meus Moyses, qui in omni domo mea fidelissimus est:
kjv: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.

wlc: פֶּה אֶל־פֶּה אֲדַבֶּר־בּוֹ וּמַרְאֶה וְלֹא בְחִידֹת וּתְמֻנַת יְהוָה יַבִּיט וּמַדּוּעַ לֹא יְרֵאתֶם לְדַבֵּר בְּעַבְדִּי בְמֹשֶׁה ׃
lxx: στόμα κατὰ στόμα λαλήσω αὐτῷ, ἐν εἴδει καὶ οὐ δι’ αἰνιγμάτων, καὶ τὴν δόξαν Κυρίου εἶδεν· καὶ διὰ τί οὐκ ἐφοβήθητε καταλαλῆσαι κατὰ τοῦ θεράποντός μου Μωυσῆ;
vulg: ore enim ad os loquor ei et palam non per enigmata et figuras Dominum videt quare igitur non timuistis detrahere servo meo Mosi
clem: ore enim ad os loquor ei: et palam, et non per nigmata et figuras Dominum videt. Quare ergo non timuistis detrahere servo meo Moysi?
kjv: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the Lord shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?

wlc: וַיִּחַר אַף יְהוָה בָּם וַיֵּלַךְ ׃
lxx: καὶ ὀργὴ θυμοῦ κυρίου ἐπ’ αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἀπῆλθεν.
vulg: iratusque contra eos abiit
clem: Iratusque contra eos, abiit:
kjv: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against them; and he departed.

wlc: וְהֶעָנָן סָר מֵעַל הָאֹהֶל וְהִנֵּה מִרְיָם מְצֹרַעַת כַּשָּׁלֶג וַיִּפֶן אַהֲרֹן אֶל־מִרְיָם וְהִנֵּה מְצֹרָעַת ׃
lxx: καὶ ἡ νεφέλη ἀπέστη ἀπὸ τῆς σκηνῆς, καὶ ἰδοὺ Μαριὰμ λεπρῶσα ὡσεὶ χιών. καὶ ἐπέβλεψεν Ἀαρὼν ἐπὶ Μαριάμ, καὶ ἰδοὺ λεπρῶσα.
vulg: nubes quoque recessit quae erat super tabernaculum et ecce Maria apparuit candens lepra quasi nix cumque respexisset eam Aaron et vidisset perfusam lepra
clem: nubes quoque recessit qu erat super tabernaculum: et ecce Maria apparuit candens lepra quasi nix. Cumque respexisset eam Aaron, et vidisset perfusam lepra,
kjv: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר אַהֲרֹן אֶל־מֹשֶׁה בִּי אֲדֹנִי אַל־נָא תָשֵׁת עָלֵינוּ חַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר נוֹאַלְנוּ וַאֲשֶׁר חָטָאנוּ ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν Ἀαρὼν πρὸς Μωυσῆν Δέομαι, κύριε, μὴ συνεπιθῇ ἡμῖν ἁμαρτίαν, ἠγνοήσαμεν καθότι ἡμάρτομεν·
vulg: ait ad Mosen obsecro domine mi ne inponas nobis hoc peccatum quod stulte commisimus
clem: ait ad Moysen: Obsecro, domine mi, ne imponas nobis hoc peccatum quod stulte commisimus,
kjv: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.

wlc: אַל־נָא תְהִי כַּמֵּת אֲשֶׁר בְּצֵאתוֹ מֵרֶחֶם אִמּוֹ וַיֵּאָכֵל חֲצִי בְשָׂרוֹ ׃
lxx: γένηται ὡσεὶ ἴσον θανάτῳ, ὡσεὶ ἔκτρωμα ἐκπορευόμενον ἐκ μήτρας μητρός· κατεσθίει τὸ ἥμισυ τῶν σαρκῶν αὐτῆς.
vulg: ne fiat haec quasi mortua et ut abortivum quod proicitur de vulva matris suae ecce iam medium carnis eius devoratum est lepra
clem: ne fiat hc quasi mortua, et ut abortivum quod projicitur de vulva matris su: ecce jam medium carnis ejus devoratum est a lepra.
kjv: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.

wlc: וַיִּצְעַק מֹשֶׁה אֶל־יְהוָה לֵאמֹר אֵל נָא רְפָא נָא לָהּ ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἐβόησεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς κύριον λέγων Ὁ θεός, δέομαί σου, ἴασαι αὐτήν.
vulg: clamavitque Moses ad Dominum dicens Deus obsecro sana eam
clem: Clamavitque Moyses ad Dominum, dicens: Deus, obsecro, sana eam.
kjv: And Moses cried unto the Lord, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאָבִיהָ יָרֹק יָרַק בְּפָנֶיהָ הֲלֹא תִכָּלֵם שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תִּסָּגֵר שִׁבְעַת יָמִים מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וְאַחַר תֵּאָסֵף ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν Εἰ ὁ πατὴρ· αὐτῆς πτύων ἐνέπτυσεν εἰς τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῆς, οὐκ ἐντραπήσεται ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ; ἀφορισθήτω ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς, καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσελεύσεται.
vulg: cui respondit Dominus si pater eius spuisset in faciem illius nonne debuerat saltem septem dierum rubore suffundi separetur septem diebus extra castra et postea revocabitur
clem: Cui respondit Dominus: Si pater ejus spuisset in faciem illius, nonne debuerat saltem septem diebus rubore suffundi? separetur septem diebus extra castra, et postea revocabitur.
kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.

wlc: וַתִּסָּגֵר מִרְיָם מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה שִׁבְעַת יָמִים וְהָעָם לֹא נָסַע עַד־הֵאָסֵף מִרְיָם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀφωρίσθη Μαριὰμ ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας· καὶ ὁ λαὸς οὐκ ἐξῆρεν ἕως ἐκαθαρίσθη Μαριάμ.
vulg: exclusa est itaque Maria extra castra septem diebus et populus non est motus de loco illo donec revocata est Maria
clem: Exclusa est itaque Maria extra castra septem diebus: et populus non est motus de loco illo, donec revocata est Maria.
kjv: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.

wlc: וְאַחַר נָסְעוּ הָעָם מֵחֲצֵרוֹת וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּמִדְבַּר פָּארָן ׃ פ
kjv: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.

wlc: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר ׃
lxx: καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἐξῆρεν ὁ λαὸς ἐξ Ἁσηρώθ, καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Φαράν.
vulg: profectus est de Aseroth fixis tentoriis in deserto Pharan
clem: Profectusque est populus de Haseroth, fixis tentoriis in deserto Pharan.
kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

wlc: שְׁלַח־לְךָ אֲנָשִׁים וְיָתֻרוּ אֶת־אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי נֹתֵן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ אֶחָד אִישׁ אֶחָד לְמַטֵּה אֲבֹתָיו תִּשְׁלָחוּ כֹּל נָשִׂיא בָהֶם ׃
lxx: Καὶ ἐλάλησεν Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων
vulg: ibi locutus est Dominus ad Mosen dicens
clem: Ibique locutus est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
kjv: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.

wlc: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה מִמִּדְבַּר פָּארָן עַל־פִּי יְהוָה כֻּלָּם אֲנָשִׁים רָאשֵׁי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵמָּה ׃
lxx: Ἀπόστειλον σεαυτῷ ἄνδρας, καὶ κατασκεψάσθωσαν τὴν γῆν τῶν χαναναίων, ἣν ἐγὼ δίδωμι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ εἰς κατάσχεσιν· ἄνδρα ἕνα κατὰ φυλήν, κατὰ δήμους πατριῶν αὐτῶν ἀποστείλας αὐτούς, πάντα ἀρχηγὸν ἐξ αὐτῶν.
vulg: mitte viros qui considerent terram Chanaan quam daturus sum filiis Israhel singulos de singulis tribubus ex principibus
clem: Mitte viros, qui considerent terram Chanaan, quam daturus sum filiis Isral, singulos de singulis tribubus, ex principibus.
kjv: And Moses by the commandment of the Lord sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.

wlc: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹתָם לְמַטֵּה רְאוּבֵן שַׁמּוּעַ בֶּן־זַכּוּר ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς Μωυσῆς ἐκ τῆς ἐρήμου Φαρᾶν διὰ φωνῆς Τυρίου· πάντες ἄνδρες ἀρχηγοὶ υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ οὗτοι.
vulg: fecit Moses quod Dominus imperarat de deserto Pharan mittens principes viros quorum ista sunt nomina
clem: Fecit Moyses quod Dominus imperaverat, de deserto Pharan mittens principes viros, quorum ista sunt nomina.
kjv: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

wlc: לְמַטֵּה שִׁמְעוֹן שָׁפָט בֶּן־חוֹרִי ׃
lxx: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν· τῆς φυλῆς Ῥουβήν, Σαμουὴλ υἱὸς Ζακχυρ.
vulg: de tribu Ruben Semmua filium Zecchur
clem: De tribu Ruben, Sammua filium Zechur.
kjv: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

wlc: לְמַטֵּה יְהוּדָה כָּלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה ׃
lxx: τῆς φυλῆς Συμεών, Σαφὰτ υἱὸς Σουρεί·
vulg: de tribu Symeon Saphat filium Huri
clem: De tribu Simeon, Saphat filium Huri.
kjv: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

wlc: לְמַטֵּה יִשָּׂשכָר יִגְאָל בֶּן־יוֹסֵף ׃
lxx: τῆς φυλῆς Ἰούδα, χαλὲβ υἱὸς Ἰεφοννή.
vulg: de tribu Iuda Chaleb filium Iepphonne
clem: De tribu Juda, Caleb filium Jephone.
kjv: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

wlc: לְמַטֵּה אֶפְרָיִם הוֹשֵׁעַ בִּן־נוּן ׃
lxx: τῆς φυλῆς Ἰσσαχάρ, Ἰλαὰλ υἱὸς Ἰωσήφ·
vulg: de tribu Isachar Igal filium Ioseph
clem: De tribu Issachar, Igal filium Joseph.
kjv: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

wlc: לְמַטֵּה בִנְיָמִן פַּלְטִי בֶּן־רָפוּא ׃
lxx: τῆς φυλῆς Ἐφράιμ, Αὑσὴ υἱὸς Ναυή·
vulg: de tribu Ephraim Osee filium Nun
clem: De tribu Ephraim, Osee filium Nun.
kjv: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

wlc: לְמַטֵּה זְבוּלֻן גַּדִּיאֵל בֶּן־סוֹדִי ׃
lxx: τῆς φυλῆς Βενιαμείν· Φαλτεὶ υἱὸς Ῥαφού·
vulg: de tribu Beniamin Phalti filium Raphu
clem: De tribu Benjamin, Phalti filium Raphu.
kjv: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

wlc: לְמַטֵּה יוֹסֵף לְמַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה גַּדִּי בֶּן־סוּסִי ׃
lxx: τῆς φυλῆς Ζαβουλών, Γουδιὴλ υἱὸς Σουδεί·
vulg: de tribu Zabulon Geddihel filium Sodi
clem: De tribu Zabulon, Geddiel filium Sodi.
kjv: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

wlc: לְמַטֵּה דָן עַמִּיאֵל בֶּן־גְּמַלִּי ׃
lxx: τῆς φυλῆς Ἰωσὴφ τῶν υἱῶν Μανασσή, Γαδδεὶ υἱὸς Σουσεί·
vulg: de tribu Ioseph sceptri Manasse Gaddi filium Susi
clem: De tribu Joseph, sceptri Manasse, Gaddi filium Susi.
kjv: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

wlc: לְמַטֵּה אָשֵׁר סְתוּר בֶּן־מִיכָאֵל ׃
lxx: τῆς φυλῆς Δάν, Ἀμειὴλ υἱὸς Γᾶμαί·
vulg: de tribu Dan Ammihel filium Gemalli
clem: De tribu Dan, Ammiel filium Gemalli.
kjv: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

wlc: לְמַטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי נַחְבִּי בֶּן־וָפְסִי ׃
lxx: τῆς φυλῆς Ἀσήρ, Σαθοὺρ υἱὸς Μειχαήλ·
vulg: de tribu Aser Sthur filium Michahel
clem: De tribu Aser, Sthur filium Michal.
kjv: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

wlc: לְמַטֵּה גָד גְּאוּאֵל בֶּן־מָכִי ׃
lxx: τῆς φυλῆς Νεφθαλεί, Ναβεὶ υἱὸς Ἰαβεί.
vulg: de tribu Nepthali Naabbi filium Vaphsi
clem: De tribu Nephthali, Nahabi filium Vapsi.
kjv: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

wlc: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לָתוּר אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וַיִּקְרָא מֹשֶׁה לְהוֹשֵׁעַ בִּן־נוּן יְהוֹשֻׁעַ ׃
lxx: τῆς φυλῆς Γάδ, Γουδιὴλ υἱὸς Μακχί.
vulg: de tribu Gad Guhel filium Machi
clem: De tribu Gad, Guel filium Machi.
kjv: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.

wlc: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֹתָם מֹשֶׁה לָתוּר אֶת־אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם עֲלוּ זֶה בַּנֶּגֶב וַעֲלִיתֶם אֶת־הָהָר ׃
lxx: ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν ἀνδρῶν οὓς ἀπ’ ἀπέστειλεν Μωυσῆς κατασκέψασθαι τὴν γῆν. καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν Μωυσῆς τὸν Λύση υἱὸν Ναυὴ Ἰησοῦν.
vulg: haec sunt nomina virorum quos misit Moses ad considerandam terram vocavitque Osee filium Nun Iosue
clem: Hc sunt nomina virorum, quos misit Moyses ad considerandam terram: vocavitque Osee filium Nun, Josue.
kjv: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:

wlc: וּרְאִיתֶם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ מַה־הִוא וְאֶת־הָעָם הַיֹּשֵׁב עָלֶיהָ הֶחָזָק הוּא הֲרָפֶה הַמְעַט הוּא אִם־רָב ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς Μωυσῆς τὴν γῆν Χανάαν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ἀνάβητε ταύτῃ τῇ ἐρήμῳ, καὶ ἀναβήσεσθε εἰς τὸ ὄρος·
vulg: misit ergo eos Moses ad considerandam terram Chanaan et dixit ad eos ascendite per meridianam plagam cumque veneritis ad montes
clem: Misit ergo eos Moyses ad considerandam terram Chanaan, et dixit ad eos: Ascendite per meridianam plagam. Cumque veneritis ad montes,
kjv: And see the land, what it is, and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;

wlc: וּמָה הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־הוּא יֹשֵׁב בָּהּ הֲטוֹבָה הִוא אִם־רָעָה וּמָה הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר־הוּא יוֹשֵׁב בָּהֵנָּה הַבְּמַחֲנִים אִם בְּמִבְצָרִים ׃
lxx: καὶ ὄψεσθε τὴν γῆν τίς ἐστιν, καὶ τὸν λαὸν τὸν ἐνκαθήμενον ἐπ’ αὐτῆς, εἰ ὀσχυρότερός ἐστιν ἢ ἀσθενής, ἢ ὀλίγοι εἰσὶν ἢ πολλοί·
vulg: considerate terram qualis sit et populum qui habitator est eius utrum fortis sit an infirmus pauci numero an plures
clem: considerate terram, qualis sit: et populum qui habitator est ejus, utrum fortis sit an infirmus: si pauci numero an plures:
kjv: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;

wlc: וּמָה הָאָרֶץ הַשְּׁמֵנָה הִוא אִם־רָזָה הֲיֵשׁ־בָּהּ עֵץ אִם־אַיִן וְהִתְחַזַּקְתֶּם וּלְקַחְתֶּם מִפְּרִי הָאָרֶץ וְהַיָּמִים יְמֵי בִּכּוּרֵי עֲנָבִים ׃
lxx: καὶ τίς ἡ γῆ εἰς ἣν οὗτοι ἐνκάθηνται ἐπ’ αὐτῆς, ἢ καλή ἐστιν ἢ πονηρά· καὶ τίνες αἱ πόλεις εἰς ἃς οὗτοι κατοικοῦσιν ἐν αὐταῖς, ἢ ἐν τειχήρεσιν ἢ ἐν ἀτειχίσταις·
vulg: ipsa terra bona an mala urbes quales muratae an absque muris
clem: ipsa terra, bona an mala: urbes quales, murat an absque muris:
kjv: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.

wlc: וַיַּעֲלוּ וַיָּתֻרוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ מִמִּדְבַּר־צִן עַד־רְחֹב לְבֹא חֲמָת ׃
lxx: καὶ τίς ἡ γῆ, ἢ πίων ἢ παρειμένη, ἢ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτῇ δένδρα ἢ οὔ. καὶ προσκαρτερήσαντες λήμψεσθε ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν τῆς γῆς. καὶ αἱ ἡμέραι ἡμέραι ἔαρος, πρόδρομοι σταφυλῆς.
vulg: humus pinguis an sterilis nemorosa an absque arboribus confortamini et adferte nobis de fructibus terrae erat autem tempus quando iam praecoquae uvae vesci possunt
clem: humus, pinguis an sterilis, nemorosa an absque arboribus. Confortamini, et afferte nobis de fructibus terr. Erat autem tempus quando jam prcoqu uv vesci possunt.
kjv: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

wlc: וַיַּעֲלוּ בַנֶּגֶב וַיָּבֹא עַד־חֶבְרוֹן וְשָׁם אֲחִימַן שֵׁשַׁי וְתַלְמַי יְלִידֵי הָעֲנָק וְחֶבְרוֹן שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים נִבְנְתָה לִפְנֵי צֹעַן מִצְרָיִם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀναβάντες κατεσκέψαντο τὴν γῆν ἀπὸ τῆς ἐρήμου Σεῖν ἕως Ῥαάβ, εἰσπορευομένων Ἑφαάθ.
vulg: cumque ascendissent exploraverunt terram a deserto Sin usque Roob intrantibus Emath
clem: Cumque ascendissent, exploraverunt terram a deserto Sin, usque Rohob intrantibus Emath.
kjv: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

wlc: וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־נַחַל אֶשְׁכֹּל וַיִּכְרְתוּ מִשָּׁם זְמוֹרָה וְאֶשְׁכּוֹל עֲנָבִים אֶחָד וַיִּשָּׂאֻהוּ בַמּוֹט בִּשְׁנָיִם וּמִן־הָרִמֹּנִים וּמִן־הַתְּאֵנִים ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀνέβησαν κατὰ τὴν ἔρημον καὶ ἦλθον ἕως Χεβρών, καὶ ἐκεῖ Ἀχειμὰν καὶ Σεσσεὶ καὶ Θελαμείν, γενεαὶ Ἐνάχ· καὶ Χεβρὼν ἑπτὰ ἔτεσιν ᾠκοδομήθη πρὸ τοῦ Τάνιν Αἰγύπτου.
vulg: ascenderuntque ad meridiem et venerunt in Hebron ubi erant Ahiman et Sisai et Tholmai filii Enach nam Hebron septem annis ante Tanim urbem Aegypti condita est
clem: Ascenderuntque ad meridiem, et venerunt in Hebron, ubi erant Achiman et Sisai et Tholmai filii Enac: nam Hebron septem annis ante Tanim urbem gypti condita est.
kjv: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

wlc: לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא קָרָא נַחַל אֶשְׁכּוֹל עַל אֹדוֹת הָאֶשְׁכּוֹל אֲשֶׁר־כָּרְתוּ מִשָּׁם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
lxx: καὶ ἦλθον ἕως Φάραγγος βότρυος, καὶ κατεσκέψαντο αὐτήν· καὶ ἔκοψαν ἐκεῖθεν κλήματα καὶ βότρυν σταφυλῆς ἕνα ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἦραν αὐτὸν ἐπ’ ἀναφορεῦσιν, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ῥοῶν καὶ ἀπότων σικύων.
vulg: pergentesque usque ad torrentem Botri absciderunt palmitem cum uva sua quem portaverunt in vecte duo viri de malis quoque granatis et de ficis loci illius tulerunt
clem: Pergentesque usque ad Torrentem botri, absciderunt palmitem cum uva sua, quem portaverunt in vecte duo viri. De malis quoque granatis et de ficis loci illius tulerunt:
kjv: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

wlc: וַיָּשֻׁבוּ מִתּוּר הָאָרֶץ מִקֵּץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם ׃
lxx: τὸν τόπον ἐκεῖνον ἐπωνόμασαν Φάραγξ βότρυος, διὰ τὸν βότρυν ὃν ἔκοψαν ἐκεῖθεν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ.
vulg: qui appellatus est Neelescol id est torrens Botri eo quod botrum inde portassent filii Israhel
clem: qui appellatus est Nehelescol, id est Torrens botri, eo quod botrum portassent inde filii Isral.
kjv: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.

wlc: וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל־אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל־כָּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־מִדְבַּר פָּארָן קָדֵשָׁה וַיָּשִׁיבוּ אוֹתָם דָּבָר וְאֶת־כָּל־הָעֵדָה וַיַּרְאוּם אֶת־פְּרִי הָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: Καὶ ἀπέστρεψαν ἐκεῖθεν κατασκεψάμενοι τὴν γῆν μετὰ τεσσεράκοντα ἡμέρας.
vulg: reversique exploratores terrae post quadraginta dies omni regione circuita
clem: Reversique exploratores terr post quadraginta dies, omni regione circuita,
kjv: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.

wlc: וַיְסַפְּרוּ־לוֹ וַיֹּאמְרוּ בָּאנוּ אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר שְׁלַחְתָּנוּ וְגַם זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ הִוא וְזֶה־פִּרְיָהּ ׃
lxx: καὶ πορευθέντες ἦλθον πρὸς Μωυσῆν κ πρὸς πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ εἰς τὴν ἔρημον Φαρᾶν καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτοῖς ῥῆμα καὶ πάση συναγωγῇ, καὶ ἔδειξαν τὸν καρπὸν τῆς γῆς.
vulg: venerunt ad Mosen et Aaron et ad omnem coetum filiorum Israhel in desertum Pharan quod est in Cades locutique eis et omni multitudini ostenderunt fructus terrae
clem: venerunt ad Moysen et Aaron et ad omnem ctum filiorum Isral in desertum Pharan, quod est in Cades. Locutique eis et omni multitudini ostenderunt fructus terr:
kjv: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

wlc: אֶפֶס כִּי־עַז הָעָם הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּאָרֶץ וְהֶעָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת גְּדֹלֹת מְאֹד וְגַם־יְלִדֵי הָעֲנָק רָאִינוּ שָׁם ׃
lxx: καὶ διηγήσαντο αὐτῷ καὶ εἶπαν Ἤλθαμεν εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἀπέστειλας ἡμᾶς, γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι, καὶ οὗτος ὁ καρπὸς αὐτῆς·
vulg: et narraverunt dicentes venimus in terram ad quam misisti nos quae re vera fluit lacte et melle ut ex his fructibus cognosci potest
clem: et narraverunt, dicentes: Venimus in terram, ad quam misisti nos, qu revera fluit lacte et melle, ut ex his fructibus cognosci potest:
kjv: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

wlc: עֲמָלֵק יוֹשֵׁב בְּאֶרֶץ הַנֶּגֶב וְהַחִתִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי וְהָאֱמֹרִי יוֹשֵׁב בָּהָר וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי יֹשֵׁב עַל־הַיָּם וְעַל יַד הַיַּרְדֵּן ׃
lxx: ἀλλ᾿ ἢ ὅτι θρασὺ τὸ ἔθνος τὸ κατοικοῦν ἐπ’ αὐτῆς, καὶ πόλεις ὀχυραὶ τετειχισμέναι καὶ μεγάλαι σφόδρα, καὶ τὴν γενεὰν Ἐνὰχ ἑωράκαμεν ἐκεῖ·
vulg: sed cultores fortissimos habet et urbes grandes atque muratas stirpem Enach vidimus ibi
clem: sed cultores fortissimos habet, et urbes grandes atque muratas. Stirpem Enac vidimus ibi.
kjv: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.

wlc: וַיַּהַס כָּלֵב אֶת־הָעָם אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר עָלֹה נַעֲלֶה וְיָרַשְׁנוּ אֹתָהּ כִּי־יָכוֹל נוּכַל לָהּ ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἀμαλὴκ κατοικεῖ ἐν τῇ γῇ τῇ πρὸς νότον, καὶ ὁ Χετταῖος καὶ ὁ Εὑαῖος καὶ ὁ Ἰεβουσαῖος καὶ ὁ Ἀμορραῖος κατοικεῖ ἐν τῇ ὀρεινῇ, καὶ ὁ Χαναναῖος κατοικεῖ παρὰ θάλασσαν.
vulg: Amalech habitat in meridie Hettheus et Iebuseus et Amorreus in montanis Chananeus vero moratur iuxta mare et circa fluenta Iordanis
clem: Amalec habitat in meridie, Hethus et Jebusus et Amorrhus in montanis: Chananus vero moratur juxta mare et circa fluenta Jordanis.
kjv: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

wlc: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־עָלוּ עִמּוֹ אָמְרוּ לֹא נוּכַל לַעֲלוֹת אֶל־הָעָם כִּי־חָזָק הוּא מִמֶּנּוּ ׃
lxx: καὶ κατεσιώπησεν Χαλὲβ τὸν λαὸν πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Οὐχί, ἀλλὰ ἀναβάντες ἀναβησόμεθα καὶ κατακληρονομήσομεν αὐτήν, ὅτι δυνατοὶ δυνησόμεθα πρὸς αὐτούς.
vulg: inter haec Chaleb conpescens murmur populi qui oriebatur contra Mosen ait ascendamus et possideamus terram quoniam poterimus obtinere eam
clem: Inter hc Caleb compescens murmur populi, qui oriebatur contra Moysen, ait: Ascendamus, et possideamus terram, quoniam poterimus obtinere eam.
kjv: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

wlc: וַיּוֹצִיאוּ דִּבַּת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תָּרוּ אֹתָהּ אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ בָהּ לָתוּר אֹתָהּ אֶרֶץ אֹכֶלֶת יוֹשְׁבֶיהָ הִוא וְכָל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־רָאִינוּ בְתוֹכָהּ אַנְשֵׁי מִדּוֹת ׃
lxx: καὶ οἱ ἄνθρωποι οἱ συναναβάντες μετ’ αὐτοῦ εἶπαν οὐκ ἀναβαίνομεν, ὅτι οὐ μὴ δυνώμεθα ἀναβῆναι πρὸς τὸ ἔθνος· ὃτι ἰσχυρότερόν ἐστιν ἡμῶν μᾶλλον.
vulg: alii vero qui fuerant cum eo dicebant nequaquam ad hunc populum valemus ascendere quia fortior nobis est
clem: Alii vero, qui fuerant cum eo, dicebant: Nequaquam ad hunc populum valemus ascendere, quia fortior nobis est.
kjv: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.

wlc: וְשָׁם רָאִינוּ אֶת־הַנְּפִילִים בְּנֵי עֲנָק מִן־הַנְּפִלִים וַנְּהִי בְעֵינֵינוּ כַּחֲגָבִים וְכֵן הָיִינוּ בְּעֵינֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐξήνεγκον ἔκστασιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἢν ντο αὐτὴν πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ λέγοντες τὴν γῆν ἢν τὰς ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ἐστίν. πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὃν ἑωράκαμεν ἐν αὐτῇ ἄνδρες ὑπερμήκεις ἐκεῖ·
vulg: detraxeruntque terrae quam inspexerant apud filios Israhel dicentes terram quam lustravimus devorat habitatores suos populum quem aspeximus procerae staturae est
clem: Detraxeruntque terr, quam inspexerant, apud filios Isral, dicentes: Terra, quam lustravimus, devorat habitatores suos: populus, quem aspeximus, procer statur est.
kjv: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

lxx: καὶ ἐκεῖ ἑωράκαμεν τοὺς γίγαντας, καὶ ἦμεν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν ὡσεὶ ἀκρίδες· ἀλλὰ καὶ οὕτως ἦμεν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν.
vulg: ibi vidimus monstra quaedam filiorum Enach de genere giganteo quibus conparati quasi lucustae videbamur
clem: Ibi vidimus monstra qudam filiorum Enac de genere giganteo: quibus comparati, quasi locust videbamur.

wlc: וַתִּשָּׂא כָּל־הָעֵדָה וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת־קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ הָעָם בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא ׃
lxx: Καὶ ἀναλαβοῦσα πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ ἐνέδωκεν φωνῇ, καὶ ἔκλαιεν ὁ λαὸς ὅλην τὴν νύκτα ἐκείνην.
vulg: igitur vociferans omnis turba flevit nocte illa
clem: Igitur vociferans omnis turba flevit nocte illa,
kjv: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

wlc: וַיִּלֹּנוּ עַל־מֹשֶׁה וְעַל־אַהֲרֹן כֹּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם כָּל־הָעֵדָה לוּ־מַתְנוּ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם אוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה לוּ־מָתְנוּ ׃
lxx: καὶ διεγόγγυζον ἐπὶ Μωυσῆν καὶ Ἀαρὼν πάντες οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτοὺς πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγή ὄφελον ἀπεθάνομεν ἐν γῆ Αἰγύπτῳ, ἢ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ταύτῃ εἰ ἀπεθάνομεν·
vulg: et murmurati sunt contra Mosen et Aaron cuncti filii Israhel dicentes
clem: et murmurati sunt contra Moysen et Aaron cuncti filii Isral, dicentes:
kjv: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!

wlc: וְלָמָה יְהוָה מֵבִיא אֹתָנוּ אֶל־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לִנְפֹּל בַּחֶרֶב נָשֵׁינוּ וְטַפֵּנוּ יִהְיוּ לָבַז הֲלוֹא טוֹב לָנוּ שׁוּב מִצְרָיְמָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἵνα τί κύριος εἰσάγει ἡμᾶς εἰς τὴν γῆν ταύτην ἐν πολέμῳ ; αἱ γυναῖκες ἡμῶν καὶ τὰ παιδία ἔσονται εἰς νῦν οὖν βέλτιον ἡμῖν ἐστιν ἀποστραφῆναι εἰς Αἴγυπτον.
vulg: utinam mortui essemus in Aegypto et non in hac vasta solitudine utinam pereamus et non inducat nos Dominus in terram istam ne cadamus gladio et uxores ac liberi nostri ducantur captivi nonne melius est reverti in Aegyptum
clem: Utinam mortui essemus in gypto: et in hac vasta solitudine utinam pereamus, et non inducat nos Dominus in terram istam, ne cadamus gladio, et uxores ac liberi nostri ducantur captivi. Nonne melius est reverti in gyptum?
kjv: And wherefore hath the Lord brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?

wlc: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־אָחִיו נִתְּנָה רֹאשׁ וְנָשׁוּבָה מִצְרָיְמָה ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπαν ἕτερος τῷ ἑτέρῳ Δῶμεν ἀρχηγὸν καὶ ἀποστρέψωμεν εἰς Αἴγυπτον.
vulg: dixeruntque alter ad alterum constituamus nobis ducem et revertamur in Aegyptum
clem: Dixeruntque alter ad alterum: Constituamus nobis ducem, et revertamur in gyptum.
kjv: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.

wlc: וַיִּפֹּל מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם לִפְנֵי כָּל־קְהַל עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
lxx: καὶ ἔπεσεν Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἀαρὼν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον ἐναντίον πάσης συναγωγῆς υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ,
vulg: quo audito Moses et Aaron ceciderunt proni in terram coram omni multitudine filiorum Israhel
clem: Quo audito, Moyses et Aaron ceciderunt proni in terram coram omni multitudine filiorum Isral.
kjv: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

wlc: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה מִן־הַתָּרִים אֶת־הָאָרֶץ קָרְעוּ בִּגְדֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: Ἰησοῦς δὲ ὁ τοῦ Ναυὴ καὶ Χαλὲβ ὁ τοῦ Ἰεφοννὴ τῶν κατασκεψαμένων τὴν γῆν διέρρηξαν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν,
vulg: at vero Iosue filius Nun et Chaleb filius Iepphonne qui et ipsi lustraverant terram sciderunt vestimenta sua
clem: At vero Josue filius Nun et Caleb filius Jephone, qui et ipsi lustraverant terram, sciderunt vestimenta sua,
kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:

wlc: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֶל־כָּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר עָבַרְנוּ בָהּ לָתוּר אֹתָהּ טוֹבָה הָאָרֶץ מְאֹד מְאֹד ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ λέγοντες Ἡ γῆ, ἣν κατεσκεψάμεθα αὐτήν, ἀγαθή ἐστιν σφόδρα σφόδρα·
vulg: et ad omnem multitudinem filiorum Israhel locuti sunt terram quam circuivimus valde bona est
clem: et ad omnem multitudinem filiorum Isral locuti sunt: Terra, quam circuivimus, valde bona est.
kjv: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.

wlc: אִם־חָפֵץ בָּנוּ יְהוָה וְהֵבִיא אֹתָנוּ אֶל־הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת וּנְתָנָהּ לָנוּ אֶרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־הִוא זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבָשׁ ׃
lxx: δεῖ αἱρετίζει ἡμᾶς κύριος, εἰσάξει ἡμᾶς εἰς τὴν γῆν ταύτην καὶ δώσει αὐτὴν ἡμῖν ἣτις γῆ ἥτις ἐστὶν ῥέουσα γάλα καὶ μέλι.
vulg: si propitius fuerit Dominus inducet nos in eam et tradet humum lacte et melle manantem
clem: Si propitius fuerit Dominus, inducet nos in eam, et tradet humum lacte et melle manantem.
kjv: If the Lord delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.

wlc: אַךְ בַּיהוָה אַל־תִּמְרֹדוּ וְאַתֶּם אַל־תִּירְאוּ אֶת־עַם הָאָרֶץ כִּי לַחְמֵנוּ הֵם סָר צִלָּם מֵעֲלֵיהֶם וַיהוָה אִתָּנוּ אַל־תִּירָאֻם ׃
lxx: ἀλλὰ ἀπὸ τοῦ κυρίου μὴ ἀποστάται γίνεσθε· ὑμεῖς δὲ μὴ φοβηθῆτε τὸν λαὸν τῆς γῆς, ὅτι κατάβρωμα ἡμῖν ἐστίν· ἀφέστηκεν γὰρ ὁ καιρὸς ἀπ’ αὐτῶν, ὁ δὲ κύριος ἐν ἡμῖν· μὴ φοβηθῆτε αὐτούς.
vulg: nolite rebelles esse contra Dominum neque timeatis populum terrae huius quia sicut panem ita eos possumus devorare recessit ab illis omne praesidium Dominus nobiscum est nolite metuere
clem: Nolite rebelles esse contra Dominum: neque timeatis populum terr hujus, quia sicut panem ita eos possumus devorare. Recessit ab eis omne prsidium: Dominus nobiscum est, nolite metuere.
kjv: Only rebel not ye against the Lord, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the Lord is with us: fear them not.

wlc: וַיֹּאמְרוּ כָּל־הָעֵדָה לִרְגּוֹם אֹתָם בָּאֲבָנִים וּכְבוֹד יְהוָה נִרְאָה בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֶל־כָּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ καταλιθοβολῆσαι αὐτούς. καὶ ἡ δόξα κυρίου ὤφθη ἐν νεφέλῃ ἐπὶ τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου πᾶσι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ.
vulg: cumque clamaret omnis multitudo et lapidibus eos vellet opprimere apparuit gloria Domini super tectum foederis cunctis filiis Israhel
clem: Cumque clamaret omnis multitudo, et lapidibus eos vellet opprimere, apparuit gloria Domini super tectum fderis cunctis filiis Isral.
kjv: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the Lord appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה עַד־אָנָה יְנַאֲצֻנִי הָעָם הַזֶּה וְעַד־אָנָה לֹא־יַאֲמִינוּ בִי בְּכֹל הָאֹתוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ ׃
lxx: Καὶ εἶπεν Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν Ἓως τίνος παροξύνει με ὁ λαὸς οὗτος; καὶ ἕως τίνος οὐ πιστεύουσίν μοι ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς σημείοις οἷς ἐποίησα ἐν αὐτοῖς
vulg: et dixit Dominus ad Mosen usquequo detrahet mihi populus iste quousque non credent mihi in omnibus signis quae feci coram eis
clem: Et dixit Dominus ad Moysen: Usquequo detrahet mihi populus iste? quousque non credent mihi, in omnibus signis qu feci coram eis?
kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?

wlc: אַכֶּנּוּ בַדֶּבֶר וְאוֹרִשֶׁנּוּ וְאֶעֱשֶׂה אֹתְךָ לְגוֹי־גָּדוֹל וְעָצוּם מִמֶּנּוּ ׃
lxx: πατάξω αὐτοὺς θανάτῳ καὶ ἀπολῶ αὐτούς, καὶ ποιήσω σὲ καὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός σου εἰς ἔθνος μέγα καὶ πολὺ μᾶλλον ἢ τοῦτο.
vulg: feriam igitur eos pestilentia atque consumam te autem faciam principem super gentem magnam et fortiorem quam haec est
clem: Feriam igitur eos pestilentia, atque consumam: te autem faciam principem super gentem magnam, et fortiorem quam hc est.
kjv: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל־יְהוָה וְשָׁמְעוּ מִצְרַיִם כִּי־הֶעֱלִיתָ בְכֹחֲךָ אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה מִקִּרְבּוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς Κύριον Καὶ ἀκούσεται Αἲγυπτος, ὅτι ἤγαγες τῇ ἰσχύι σου τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον ἐξ αὐτῶν·
vulg: et ait Moses ad Dominum ut audiant Aegyptii de quorum medio eduxisti populum istum
clem: Et ait Moyses ad Dominum: Ut audiant gyptii, de quorum medio eduxisti populum istum,
kjv: And Moses said unto the Lord, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)

wlc: וְאָמְרוּ אֶל־יוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת שָׁמְעוּ כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה בְּקֶרֶב הָעָם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר־עַיִן בְּעַיִן נִרְאָה אַתָּה יְהוָה וַעֲנָנְךָ עֹמֵד עֲלֵהֶם וּבְעַמֻּד עָנָן אַתָּה הֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵיהֶם יוֹמָם וּבְעַמּוּד אֵשׁ לָיְלָה ׃
lxx: ἀλλὰ καὶ πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἔπὶ τῆς γῆς ταύτης ἀκηκόασιν ὅτι σὺ εἶ Κύριος ἐν τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ, ὃστις ὀφθαλμοῖς κατ᾿ ὀφθαλμοὺς ὀπτάζῃ, Κύριε. καὶ ἡ νεφέλη σου ἐφέστηκεν ἐπ᾿ αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐν στύλῳ νεφέλης συνπορεύῃ πρότερος αὐτῶν τὴν ἡμέραν καὶ ἐν στύλῳ πυρὸς τὴν νύκτα.
vulg: et habitatores terrae huius qui audierunt quod tu Domine in populo isto sis et facie videaris ad faciem et nubes tua protegat illos et in columna nubis praecedas eos per diem et in columna ignis per noctem
clem: et habitatores terr hujus, qui audierunt quod tu, Domine, in populo isto sis, et facie videaris ad faciem, et nubes tua protegat illos, et in columna nubis prcedas eos per diem, et in columna ignis per noctem:
kjv: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou Lord art among this people, that thou Lord art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.

wlc: וְהֵמַתָּה אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד וְאָמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמְעוּ אֶת־שִׁמְעֲךָ לֵאמֹר ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐκτρίψεις τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον ὡσεὶ ἄνθρωπον ἕνα, καὶ ἐροῦσιν τὰ ἔθνη ὃσοι ἀκηκόασιν τὸ ὄνομά σου λέγοντες
vulg: quod occideris tantam multitudinem quasi unum hominem et dicant
clem: quod occideris tantam multitudinem quasi unum hominem, et dicant:
kjv: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,

wlc: מִבִּלְתִּי יְכֹלֶת יְהוָה לְהָבִיא אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּע לָהֶם וַיִּשְׁחָטֵם בַּמִּדְבָּר ׃
lxx: Παρὰ τὸ μὴ δύνασθαι Κύριον εἰσαγαγεῖν τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσεν αὐτοῖς, κατέστρωσεν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ.
vulg: non poterat introducere populum in terram pro qua iuraverat idcirco occidit eos in solitudine
clem: Non poterat introducere populum in terram pro qua juraverat: idcirco occidit eos in solitudine?
kjv: Because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.

wlc: וְעַתָּה יִגְדַּל־נָא כֹּחַ אֲדֹנָי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ לֵאמֹר ׃
lxx: καὶ νῦν ὑψωθήτω ἡ ἰσχύς σου, Κύριε, ὃν τρόπον εἶπας λέγων
vulg: magnificetur ergo fortitudo Domini sicut iurasti dicens
clem: Magnificetur ergo fortitudo Domini sicut jurasti, dicens:
kjv: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,

wlc: יְהוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן וָפָשַׁע וְנַקֵּה לֹא יְנַקֶּה פֹּקֵד עֲוֹן אָבוֹת עַל־בָּנִים עַל־שִׁלֵּשִׁים וְעַל־רִבֵּעִים ׃
lxx: Κύριος μακρόθυμος καὶ πολυέλεος καὶ ἀληθινός, ἀφαιρῶν ἀνομίας καὶ ἀδικίας καὶ ἁμαρτίας· καὶ καθαρισμῷ οὐ καθαριεῖ τὸν ἔνοχον, ἀποδιδοὺς ἁμαρτίας πατέρων ἐπὶ τέκνα ἕως τρίτης καὶ τετάρτης.
vulg: Dominus patiens et multae misericordiae auferens iniquitatem et scelera nullumque innoxium derelinquens qui visitas peccata patrum in filios in tertiam et quartam generationem
clem: Dominus patiens et mult misericordi, auferens iniquitatem et scelera, nullumque innoxium derelinquens, qui visitas peccata patrum in filios in tertiam et quartam generationem.
kjv: The Lord is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.

wlc: סְלַח־נָא לַעֲוֹן הָעָם הַזֶּה כְּגֹדֶל חַסְדֶּךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁר נָשָׂאתָה לָעָם הַזֶּה מִמִּצְרַיִם וְעַד־הֵנָּה ׃
lxx: ἂφες τὴν ἁμαρτίαν τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ κατὰ τὸ μέγα ἔλεός σου, καθάπερ ἳλεως αὐτοῖς ἐγένου ἀπ᾿ Αἰγύπτου ἕως τοῦ νῦν.
vulg: dimitte obsecro peccatum populi tui huius secundum magnitudinem misericordiae tuae sicut propitius fuisti egredientibus de Aegypto usque ad locum istum
clem: Dimitte, obsecro, peccatum populi hujus secundum magnitudinem misericordi tu, sicut propitius fuisti egredientibus de gypto usque ad locum istum.
kjv: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה סָלַחְתִּי כִּדְבָרֶךָ ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν Ἵλεως αὐτοῖς εἰμὶ κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου·
vulg: dixitque Dominus dimisi iuxta verbum tuum
clem: Dixitque Dominus: Dimisi juxta verbum tuum.
kjv: And the Lord said, I have pardoned according to thy word:

wlc: וְאוּלָם חַי־אָנִי וְיִמָּלֵא כְבוֹד־יְהוָה אֶת־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: ἀλλὰ ζῶ ἐγὼ καὶ ζῶν τὸ ὄνομά μου, καὶ ἐμπλήσει ἡ δόξα Κυρίου πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν.
vulg: vivo ego et implebitur gloria Domini universa terra
clem: Vivo ego: et implebitur gloria Domini universa terra.
kjv: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord.

wlc: כִּי כָל־הָאֲנָשִׁים הָרֹאִים אֶת־כְּבֹדִי וְאֶת־אֹתֹתַי אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתִי בְמִצְרַיִם וּבַמִּדְבָּר וַיְנַסּוּ אֹתִי זֶה עֶשֶׂר פְּעָמִים וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹלִי ׃
lxx: ὃτι πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ ὁρῶντες τὴν δόξαν μου καὶ τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐποίησα ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, καὶ ἐπείρασάν με τοῦτο δέκατον καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσάν μου τῆς φωνῆς,
vulg: attamen omnes homines qui viderunt maiestatem meam et signa quae feci in Aegypto et in solitudine et temptaverunt me iam per decem vices nec oboedierunt voci meae
clem: Attamen omnes homines qui viderunt majestatem meam, et signa qu feci in gypto et in solitudine, et tentaverunt me jam per decem vices, nec obedierunt voci me,
kjv: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;

wlc: אִם־יִרְאוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָם וְכָל־מְנַאֲצַי לֹא יִרְאוּהָ ׃
lxx: εἰ μὴν οὐκ ὄψονται τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσα τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν· ἀλλ᾿ ἢ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν ἃ ἐστιν μετ᾿ ἐμοῦ ὧδε, ὅσοι οὐκ οἴδασιν ἀγαθὸν οὐδὲ κακόν, πᾶς νεώτερος ἄπειρος, τούτοις δώσω τὴν γῆν· πάντες δὲ οἱ παροξύναντές με οὐκ ὄψονται αὐτήν.
vulg: non videbunt terram pro qua iuravi patribus eorum nec quisquam ex illis qui detraxit mihi intuebitur eam
clem: non videbunt terram pro qua juravi patribus eorum, nec quisquam ex illis qui detraxit mihi, intuebitur eam.
kjv: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:

wlc: וְעַבְדִּי כָלֵב עֵקֶב הָיְתָה רוּחַ אַחֶרֶת עִמּוֹ וַיְמַלֵּא אַחֲרָי וַהֲבִיאֹתִיו אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־בָּא שָׁמָּה וְזַרְעוֹ יוֹרִשֶׁנָּה ׃
lxx: ὁ δὲ παῖς μου Χαλέβ, ὃτι ἐγενήθη πνεῦμα ἕτερον ἐν αὐτῷ, καὶ ἐπηκολούθησέν μοι, εἰσάξω αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν γῆν εἰς ἣν εἰσῆλθεν ἐκεῖ, καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ κληρονομήσει αὐτήν. ὁ δὲ Ἀμαλὴκ καὶ ὁ Χαναναῖος κατοικοῦσιν ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι·
vulg: servum meum Chaleb qui plenus alio spiritu secutus est me inducam in terram hanc quam circuivit et semen eius possidebit eam
clem: Servum meum Caleb, qui plenus alio spiritu secutus est me, inducam in terram hanc, quam circuivit; et semen ejus possidebit eam.
kjv: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

wlc: וְהָעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב בָּעֵמֶק מָחָר פְּנוּ וּסְעוּ לָכֶם הַמִּדְבָּר דֶּרֶךְ יַם־סוּף ׃ פ
lxx: αὔριον ἐπιστράφητε ὑμεῖς καὶ ἀπάρατε εἰς τὴν ἔρημον, ὁδὸν θάλασσαν ἐρυθρόν.
vulg: quoniam Amalechites et Chananeus habitant in vallibus cras movete castra et revertimini in solitudinem per viam maris Rubri
clem: Quoniam Amalecites et Chananus habitant in vallibus. Cras movete castra, et revertimini in solitudinem per viam maris Rubri.
kjv: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) Tomorrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

wlc: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל־אַהֲרֹן לֵאמֹר ׃
lxx: Καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ἀαρὼν λέγων
vulg: locutusque est Dominus ad Mosen et Aaron dicens
clem: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron, dicens:
kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

wlc: עַד־מָתַי לָעֵדָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר הֵמָּה מַלִּינִים עָלָי אֶת־תְּלֻנּוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר הֵמָּה מַלִּינִים עָלַי שָׁמָעְתִּי ׃
lxx: Ἓως τίνος τὴν συναγωγὴν τὴν πονηρὰν ταύτην ; αὐτοὶ γογγύζουσιν ἐναντίον ἐμοῦ· τὴν γόγγυσιν τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ, ἣν ἐγόγγυσαν περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀκήκοα.
vulg: usquequo multitudo haec pessima murmurat contra me querellas filiorum Israhel audivi
clem: Usquequo multitudo hc pessima murmurat contra me? querelas filiorum Isral audivi.
kjv: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

wlc: אֱמֹר אֲלֵהֶם חַי־אָנִי נְאֻם־יְהוָה אִם־לֹא כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתֶּם בְּאָזְנָי כֵּן אֶעֱשֶׂה לָכֶם ׃
lxx: εἰπὸν αὐτοῖς Ζῶ ἐγώ, λέγει κύριος, εἰ μὴν ὃν τρόπον λελαλήκατε εἰς τὰ ὦτά μου, οὕτως ποιήσω ὑμῖν·
vulg: dic ergo eis vivo ego ait Dominus sicut locuti estis audiente me sic faciam vobis
clem: Dic ergo eis: Vivo ego, ait Dominus: sicut locuti estis audiente me, sic faciam vobis.
kjv: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the Lord, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:

wlc: בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה יִפְּלוּ פִגְרֵיכֶם וְכָל־פְּקֻדֵיכֶם לְכָל־מִסְפַּרְכֶם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה אֲשֶׁר הֲלִינֹתֶם עָלָי ׃
lxx: ἦέν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ταύτῃ πεσεῖται τὰ κῶλα ὑμῶν καὶ πᾶσα ἡ ἐπισκοπὴ ὑμῶν καὶ οἱ κατηριθμημένοι ὑμῶν ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω, ὅσοι ἐγόγγυσαν ἐπ’ ἐμοί·
vulg: in solitudine hac iacebunt cadavera vestra omnes qui numerati estis a viginti annis et supra et murmurastis contra me
clem: In solitudine hac jacebunt cadavera vestra. Omnes qui numerati estis a viginti annis et supra, et murmurastis contra me,
kjv: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward which have murmured against me.

wlc: אִם־אַתֶּם תָּבֹאוּ אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָשָׂאתִי אֶת־יָדִי לְשַׁכֵּן אֶתְכֶם בָּהּ כִּי אִם־כָּלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן ׃
lxx: εἰ ὑμεῖς εἰσελεύσεσθε εἰς τὴν γῆν ἐφ’ ἢν ἐξέτεινα τὴν χεῖρά μου κατασκηνῶσαι ὑμᾶς ἐπ’ αὐτῆς, ἁλλ’ ἢ Χαλὲβ υἱὸς ἡ καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ναυή.
vulg: non intrabitis terram super quam levavi manum meam ut habitare vos facerem praeter Chaleb filium Iepphonne et Iosue filium Nun
clem: non intrabitis terram, super quam levavi manum meam ut habitare vos facerem, prter Caleb filium Jephone, et Josue filium Nun.
kjv: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

wlc: וְטַפְּכֶם אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם לָבַז יִהְיֶה וְהֵבֵיאתִי אֹתָם וְיָדְעוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר מְאַסְתֶּם בָּהּ ׃
lxx: καὶ τὰ παιδία ἃ εἴπατε ἐν διαρθαι, θαι, εἰσάξω εἰς τὴν γῆν, καὶ κληρονομήσουσιν τὴν γῆν ἢν ὑμεῖς ἀπέστητε ἀπ’ αὐτῆς.
vulg: parvulos autem vestros de quibus dixistis quod praedae hostibus forent introducam ut videant terram quae vobis displicuit
clem: Parvulos autem vestros, de quibus dixistis quod prd hostibus forent, introducam, ut videant terram, qu vobis displicuit.
kjv: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.

wlc: וּפִגְרֵיכֶם אַתֶּם יִפְּלוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה ׃
lxx: καὶ τὰ κῶλα ὑμῶν πεσεῖται ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ταύτῃ·
vulg: vestra cadavera iacebunt in solitudine
clem: Vestra cadavera jacebunt in solitudine.
kjv: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.

wlc: וּבְנֵיכֶם יִהְיוּ רֹעִים בַּמִּדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וְנָשְׂאוּ אֶת־זְנוּתֵיכֶם עַד־תֹּם פִּגְרֵיכֶם בַּמִּדְבָּר ׃
lxx: οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν ἔσονται νεμόμενοι ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη, καὶ ἀνοίσουσιν τὴν πορνείαν ὑμῶν ἕως ἀναλωθῇ τὰ κῶλα ὑμῶν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ.
vulg: filii vestri erunt vagi in deserto annis quadraginta et portabunt fornicationem vestram donec consumantur cadavera patrum in deserto
clem: Filii vestri erunt vagi in deserto annis quadraginta, et portabunt fornicationem vestram, donec consumantur cadavera patrum in deserto,
kjv: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.

wlc: בְּמִסְפַּר הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר־תַּרְתֶּם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם יוֹם לַשָּׁנָה יוֹם לַשָּׁנָה תִּשְׂאוּ אֶת־עֲוֹנֹתֵיכֶם אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וִידַעְתֶּם אֶת־תְּנוּאָתִי ׃
lxx: κατὰ τὸν ἀριθμὸν τῶν ἡμερῶν ὅσας κατεσκέψασθε τὴν γῆν, τεσσεράκοντα ἡμέρας, ἡμέραν τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ, λήμψεσθε τὰς ἁμαρτίας ὑμῶν τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη, καὶ γνώσεσθε τὸν θυμὸν τῆς ὀργῆς μου.
vulg: iuxta numerum quadraginta dierum quibus considerastis terram annus pro die inputabitur et quadraginta annis recipietis iniquitates vestras et scietis ultionem meam
clem: juxta numerum quadraginta dierum, quibus considerastis terram: annus pro die imputabitur. Et quadraginta annis recipietis iniquitates vestras, et scietis ultionem meam:
kjv: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.

wlc: אֲנִי יְהוָה דִּבַּרְתִּי אִם־לֹא זֹאת אֶעֱשֶׂה לְכָל־הָעֵדָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת הַנּוֹעָדִים עָלָי בַּמִּדְבָּר הַזֶּה יִתַּמּוּ וְשָׁם יָמֻתוּ ׃
lxx: ἐγὼ Κύριος ἐλάλησα, εἰ μὴ οὕτως ποιήσω τῇ συναγωγῇ τῇ πονηρᾷ ταύτῃ τῇ ἐπισυνεσταμένῃ ἐπ’ ἐμέ· ἐν τῆ ἐρήμῳ ταύτῃ ἐξαναλωθήσονται καὶ ἐκεῖ ἀποθανοῦνται.
vulg: quoniam sicut locutus sum ita faciam omni multitudini huic pessimae quae consurrexit adversum me in solitudine hac deficiet et morietur
clem: quoniam sicut locutus sum, ita faciam omni multitudini huic pessim, qu consurrexit adversum me: in solitudine hac deficiet, et morietur.
kjv: I the Lord have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

wlc: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַח מֹשֶׁה לָתוּר אֶת־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּשֻׁבוּ וַיִּלּוֹנוּ עָלָיו אֶת־כָּל־הָעֵדָה לְהוֹצִיא דִבָּה עַל־הָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: καὶ οἱ ἂνθρωποι οὓς ἀπέστειλεν Μωυσῆς κατασκέψασθαι τὴν γῆν, καὶ παραγενηθέντες διεγόγγυσαν κατ’ αὐτῆς πρὸς τὴν συναγωγὴν ἐξενέγκαι ῥήματα πονηρὰ περὶ τῆς γῆς,
vulg: igitur omnes viri quos miserat Moses ad contemplandam terram et qui reversi murmurare fecerant contra eum omnem multitudinem detrahentes terrae quod esset mala
clem: Igitur omnes viri, quos miserat Moyses ad contemplandam terram, et qui reversi murmurare fecerant contra eum omnem multitudinem, detrahentes terr quod esset mala,
kjv: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,

wlc: וַיָּמֻתוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים מוֹצִאֵי דִבַּת־הָאָרֶץ רָעָה בַּמַּגֵּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπέθανον οἱ ανθρωποι οἱ κατείπαντες κατὰ τῆς γῆς πονηρὰ ἐν τῇ πληγῇ ἔναντι Κυρίου·
vulg: mortui sunt atque percussi in conspectu Domini
clem: mortui sunt atque percussi in conspectu Domini.
kjv: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the Lord.

wlc: וִיהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן וְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה חָיוּ מִן־הָאֲנָשִׁים הָהֵם הַהֹלְכִים לָתוּר אֶת־הָאָרֶץ ׃
lxx: κοὶ Ἰησοῦς υἱὸς Ναυὴ καὶ Χαλὲβ υἱὸς Ἰεφοννὴ ἔζησαν ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐκείνων τῶν πεπορευμένων κατασκέψασθαι τὴν γῆν.
vulg: Iosue autem filius Nun et Chaleb filius Iepphonne vixerunt ex omnibus qui perrexerant ad considerandam terram
clem: Josue autem filius Nun, et Caleb filius Jephone, vixerunt ex omnibus qui perrexerant ad considerandam terram.
kjv: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.

wlc: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־כָּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְאַבְּלוּ הָעָם מְאֹד ׃
lxx: Καὶ ἐλάλησεν Μωυσῆς τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα πρὸς πάντας υἱοὺς Ἰσραήλ, καὶ ἐπένθησεν ὁ λαὸς σφόδρα.
vulg: locutusque est Moses universa verba haec ad omnes filios Israhel et luxit populus nimis
clem: Locutusque est Moyses universa verba hc ad omnes filios Isral, et luxit populus nimis.
kjv: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

wlc: וַיַּשְׁכִּמוּ בַבֹּקֶר וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶל־רֹאשׁ־הָהָר לֵאמֹר הִנֶּנּוּ וְעָלִינוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־אָמַר יְהוָה כִּי חָטָאנוּ ׃
lxx: καὶ ὀρθρίσαντες τὸ πρωὶ ἀνέβησαν εἰς τὴν κορυφὴν τοῦ ὄρους λέγοντες ἰδοὺ οἵδε ἡμεῖς ἀναβησόμεθα εἰς τὸν τόπον ὃν εἶπεν κύριος, ὅτι ἡμάρτομεν
vulg: et ecce mane primo surgentes ascenderunt verticem montis atque dixerunt parati sumus ascendere ad locum de quo Dominus locutus est quia peccavimus
clem: Et ecce mane primo surgentes ascenderunt verticem montis, atque dixerunt: Parati sumus ascendere ad locum, de quo Dominus locutus est: quia peccavimus.
kjv: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the Lord hath promised: for we have sinned.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה לָמָּה זֶּה אַתֶּם עֹבְרִים אֶת־פִּי יְהוָה וְהִוא לֹא תִצְלָח ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν ἵνα τί ὑμεῖς παραβαίνετε τὸ ῥῆμα Κυρίου ; οὐκ οὐκ εὔοδα ὒ
vulg: quibus Moses cur inquit transgredimini verbum Domini quod vobis non cedet in prosperum
clem: Quibus Moyses: Cur, inquit, transgredimini verbum Domini, quod vobis non cedet in prosperum?
kjv: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the Lord? but it shall not prosper.

wlc: אַל־תַּעֲלוּ כִּי אֵין יְהוָה בְּקִרְבְּכֶם וְלֹא תִּנָּגְפוּ לִפְנֵי אֹיְבֵיכֶם ׃
lxx: μὴ ἀναβαίνετε, οὐ γάρ ἐστιν κύριος μεθ’ ὑμῶν, καὶ πεσεῖσθε πρὸ προσώπου τῶν ἐχθρῶν ὑμῶν.
vulg: nolite ascendere non enim est Dominus vobiscum ne corruatis coram inimicis vestris
clem: nolite ascendere: non enim est Dominus vobiscum: ne corruatis coram inimicis vestris.
kjv: Go not up, for the Lord is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.

wlc: כִּי הָעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי שָׁם לִפְנֵיכֶם וּנְפַלְתֶּם בֶּחָרֶב כִּי־עַל־כֵּן שַׁבְתֶּם מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהוָה וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה יְהוָה עִמָּכֶם ׃
lxx: ὃτι ὁ Ἀμαλὴκ καὶ ὁ Χαναναῖος ἐκεῖ ἔμπροσθεν ὑμῶν, καὶ πεσεῖσθε μαχαίρᾳ· οὗ εἵνεκεν ἀπεστράφητε ἀπειθοῦντες κυρίῳ, καὶ οὐκ ἔσται κύριος ἐν ὑμῖν.
vulg: Amalechites et Chananeus ante vos sunt quorum gladio corruetis eo quod nolueritis adquiescere Domino nec erit Dominus vobiscum
clem: Amalecites et Chananus ante vos sunt, quorum gladio corruetis, eo quod nolueritis acquiescere Domino: nec erit Dominus vobiscum.
kjv: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the Lord, therefore the Lord will not be with you.

wlc: וַיַּעְפִּלוּ לַעֲלוֹת אֶל־רֹאשׁ הָהָר וַאֲרוֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה וּמֹשֶׁה לֹא־מָשׁוּ מִקֶּרֶב הַמַּחֲנֶה ׃
lxx: καὶ διαβιασάμενοι ἀνέβησαν ἐπὶ τὴν κορυφὴν τοῦ ὄρους· ἡ δὲ κιβωτὸς τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου καὶ Μωυσῆς οὐκ ἐκινήθησαν ἐκ τῆς παρ’ ἐμβολὴ
vulg: at illi contenebrati ascenderunt in verticem montis arca autem testamenti Domini et Moses non recesserunt de castris
clem: At illi contenebrati ascenderunt in verticem montis. Arca autem testamenti Domini et Moyses non recesserunt de castris.
kjv: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

wlc: וַיֵּרֶד הָעֲמָלֵקִי וְהַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיֹּשֵׁב בָּהָר הַהוּא וַיַּכּוּם וַיַּכְּתוּם עַד־הַחָרְמָה ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ κατέβη ὁ Ἀμαλὴκ καὶ ὁ Χαναναῖος ὁ ἐνκαθήμενος ἐν τῷ ὄρει ἐκείνῳ, καὶ ἐτρέψαντο αὐτοὺς καὶ κατέκοψαν αὐτοὺς ἕως Ἑρμᾶν· καὶ ἀπεστράφησαν εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν.
vulg: descenditque Amalechites et Chananeus qui habitabant in monte et percutiens eos atque concidens persecutus est usque Horma
clem: Descenditque Amalecites et Chananus, qui habitabat in monte: et percutiens eos atque concidens, persecutus est eos usque Horma.
kjv: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.

wlc: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר ׃
lxx: Καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων
vulg: locutus est Dominus ad Mosen dicens
clem: Locutus est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

wlc: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם כִּי תָבֹאוּ אֶל־אֶרֶץ מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן לָכֶם ׃
lxx: Λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς ’l καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς Ὃταν εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν γῆν τῆς ὑμῶν ἣν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ὑμῖν,
vulg: loquere ad filios Israhel et dices ad eos cum ingressi fueritis terram habitationis vestrae quam ego dabo vobis
clem: Loquere ad filios Isral, et dices ad eos: Cum ingressi fueritis terram habitationis vestr, quam ego dabo vobis,
kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,

wlc: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה עֹלָה אוֹ־זֶבַח לְפַלֵּא־נֶדֶר אוֹ בִנְדָבָה אוֹ בְּמֹעֲדֵיכֶם לַעֲשׂוֹת רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָה מִן־הַבָּקָר אוֹ מִן־הַצֹּאן ׃
lxx: καὶ ποιήσεις ὁλοκαυτώματα Κυρίῳ, ὀλοκάρπωμα ἢ θυσίαν, μεγαλῦναι εὐχὴν ἢ καθ’ ἑκούσιον, ἢ ἐν ταῖς ἑορταῖς ὑμῶν ποιῆσαι ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας Κυρίῳ, εἰ μὲν ἀπὸ τῶν βοῶν ἢ ἀπὸ τῶν προβάτων·
vulg: et feceritis oblationem Domino in holocaustum aut victimam vota solventes vel sponte offerentes munera aut in sollemnitatibus vestris adolentes odorem suavitatis Domino de bubus sive de ovibus
clem: et feceritis oblationem Domino in holocaustum, aut victimam, vota solventes, vel sponte offerentes munera, aut in solemnitatibus vestris adolentes odorem suavitatis Domino, de bobus sive de ovibus:
kjv: And will make an offering by fire unto the Lord, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the Lord, of the herd or of the flock:

wlc: וְהִקְרִיב הַמַּקְרִיב קָרְבָּנוֹ לַיהוָה מִנְחָה סֹלֶת עִשָּׂרוֹן בָּלוּל בִּרְבִעִית הַהִין שָׁמֶן ׃
lxx: καὶ προσοίσει ὁ προσφέρων τὸ δῶρον αὐτοῦ κυρίῳ, θυσίαν σεμιδάλεως, δέκατον τοῦ οἰφί, ἀναπεποιημένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ ἐν τετάρτῳ τοῦ εἵν·
vulg: offeret quicumque immolaverit victimam sacrificium similae decimam partem oephi conspersae oleo quod mensuram habebit quartam partem hin
clem: offeret quicumque immolaverit victimam, sacrificium simil, decimam partem ephi, conspers oleo, quod mensuram habebit quartam partem hin:
kjv: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the Lord bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.

wlc: וְיַיִן לַנֶּסֶךְ רְבִיעִית הַהִין תַּעֲשֶׂה עַל־הָעֹלָה אוֹ לַזָּבַח לַכֶּבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד ׃
lxx: καὶ οἶνον εἰς σπονδὴν τὸ τέταρτον τοῦ εἳν ποιήσετε ἐπὶ τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως ἢ ἐπὶ τῆς θυσίας· τῷ ἀμνῷ τῶ ἑνὶ ποιήσεις τοσοῦτο, κάρπωμα, ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας τῷ κυρίῳ.
vulg: et vinum ad liba fundenda eiusdem mensurae dabit in holocausto sive in victima per agnos singulos
clem: et vinum ad liba fundenda ejusdem mensur dabit in holocaustum sive in victimam. Per agnos singulos
kjv: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.

wlc: אוֹ לָאַיִל תַּעֲשֶׂה מִנְחָה סֹלֶת שְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן שְׁלִשִׁית הַהִין ׃
lxx: καὶ τῷ κριῷ, ὃταν ποιῆτε αὐτὸν ἢ εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα ἢ εἰς θυσίαν, ποιήσεις θυσίαν σεμιδάλεως δύο δέκατα ἀναπεποιημένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ, τὸ τρίτον τοῦ
vulg: et arietis erit sacrificium similae duarum decimarum quae conspersa sit oleo tertiae partis hin
clem: et arietes erit sacrificium simil duarum decimarum, qu conspersa sit oleo terti partis hin:
kjv: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.

wlc: וְיַיִן לַנֶּסֶךְ שְׁלִשִׁית הַהִין תַּקְרִיב רֵיחַ־נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָה ׃
lxx: καὶ οἶνον εἰς σπονδὴν τὸ τρίτον τοῦ εἳν προσοίσετε εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ.
vulg: et vinum ad libamentum tertiae partis eiusdem mensurae offeret in odorem suavitatis Domino
clem: et vinum ad libamentum terti partis ejusdem mensur offeret in odorem suavitatis Domino.
kjv: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the Lord.

wlc: וְכִי־תַעֲשֶׂה בֶן־בָּקָר עֹלָה אוֹ־זָבַח לְפַלֵּא־נֶדֶר אוֹ־שְׁלָמִים לַיהוָה ׃
lxx: ἐὰν δὲ ἀπὸ τῶν βοῶν ποιῆτε εἰς ὁλοἢ καύτωμα ἢ εἰς θυσίαν μεγαλῦναι εὐχὴν εἰς σωτήριον Κυρίῳ,
vulg: quando vero de bubus feceris holocaustum aut hostiam ut impleas votum vel pacificas victimas
clem: Quando vero de bobus feceris holocaustum aut hostiam, ut impleas votum vel pacificas victimas,
kjv: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the Lord:

wlc: וְהִקְרִיב עַל־בֶּן־הַבָּקָר מִנְחָה סֹלֶת שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים בָּלוּל בַּשֶּׁמֶן חֲצִי הַהִין ׃
lxx: καὶ προσοίσει ἐπὶ τοῦ μόσχου θυσίαν σεμιδάλεως τρία δέκατα ἀναπεποιημένης ἐν ἐλαίῳ, ἥμισυ τοῦ εἵν,
vulg: dabis per singulos boves similae tres decimas conspersae oleo quod habeat medium mensurae hin
clem: dabis per singulos boves simil tres decimas conspers oleo, quod habeat medium mensur hin:
kjv: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.

wlc: וְיַיִן תַּקְרִיב לַנֶּסֶךְ חֲצִי הַהִין אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ־נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָה ׃
lxx: κάρπωμα ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ.
vulg: et vinum ad liba fundenda eiusdem mensurae in oblationem suavissimi odoris Domino
clem: et vinum ad liba fundenda ejusdem mensur in oblationem suavissimi odoris Domino.
kjv: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

wlc: כָּכָה יֵעָשֶׂה לַשּׁוֹר הָאֶחָד אוֹ לָאַיִל הָאֶחָד אוֹ־לַשֶּׂה בַכְּבָשִׂים אוֹ בָעִזִּים ׃
lxx: οὓτως ποιήσεις τῷ μόσχῳ τῷ ἑνὶ ἢ τῷ κριῷ τῷ ἑνὶ ἢ τῷ ἀμνῷ τῷ ἑνὶ ἐκ τῶν προβάτων ἢ ἐκ τῶν αἰγῶν·
vulg: sic facietis
clem: Sic facies
kjv: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

wlc: כַּמִּסְפָּר אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ כָּכָה תַּעֲשׂוּ לָאֶחָד כְּמִסְפָּרָם ׃
lxx: κατὰ τὸν ἀριθμὸν ὧν ἐὰν ποιήσητε, οὕτω ποιήσετε τῷ ἑνὶ κατὰ τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν.
vulg: per singulos boves et arietes et agnos et hedos
clem: per singulos boves et arietis et agnos et hdos.
kjv: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.

wlc: כָּל־הָאֶזְרָח יַעֲשֶׂה־כָּכָה אֶת־אֵלֶּה לְהַקְרִיב אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ־נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָה ׃
lxx: πᾶς ὁ αὐτόχθων ποιήσει οὕτως τοιαῦτα, προσενέγκαι καρπώματα εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ.
vulg: tam indigenae quam peregrini
clem: Tam indigen quam peregrini
kjv: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

wlc: וְכִי־יָגוּר אִתְּכֶם גֵּר אוֹ אֲשֶׁר־בְּתוֹכְכֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם וְעָשָׂה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ־נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשׂוּ כֵּן יַעֲשֶׂה ׃
lxx: ἐὰν δὲ προσήλυτος ἐν ὑμῖν προσγένηται ἐν τῇ γῇ ὑμῶν ἢ ὃς ἀν’ γένηται ἐν ὑμῖν ἐν ταῖς γενεαῖς ὑμῶν, καὶ κάρπωμα ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ, ὃν τρόπον ποιεῖτε ὑμεῖς, οὕτω ἡ συναγωγὴ Κυρίῳ.
vulg: eodem ritu offerent sacrificia
clem: eodem ritu offerent sacrificia.
kjv: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord; as ye do, so he shall do.

wlc: הַקָּהָל חֻקָּה אַחַת לָכֶם וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם כָּכֶם כַּגֵּר יִהְיֶה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה ׃
lxx: νόμος εἷς ἱστᾶι ὑμῖν καὶ τοῖς προσηλύτοις τοῖς προσκειμένοις ἐν ὑμῖν, νόμος αἰώνιος εἰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν· ὡς ὑμεῖς, καὶ ὁ προσήλυτος ἔσται ἔναντι Τυρίου.
vulg: unum praeceptum erit atque iudicium tam vobis quam advenis terrae
clem: Unum prceptum erit atque judicium tam vobis quam advenis terr.
kjv: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the Lord.

wlc: תּוֹרָה אַחַת וּמִשְׁפָּט אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לָכֶם וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר אִתְּכֶם ׃ פ
lxx: νόμος εἷς ἔσται κα δικαίωμα ἱν ἔσται καὶ τῷ προσηλύτῳ τῷ προσκειμένῳ ἐν ὺμῖν.
vulg: locutus est Dominus ad Mosen dicens
clem: Locutus est Dominus ad Moysen, dicens:
kjv: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

wlc: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר ׃
lxx: Καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων
vulg: loquere filiis Israhel et dices ad eos
clem: Loquere filiis Isral, et dices ad eos:
kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

wlc: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם בְּבֹאֲכֶם אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי מֵבִיא אֶתְכֶם שָׁמָּה ׃
lxx: Λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς Ἐν τῷ εἰσπορεύεσθαι ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν γῆν εἰς ἣν ἐγὼ εἰσάγω ὑμᾶς ἐκεῖ,
vulg: cum veneritis in terram quam dabo vobis
clem: Cum veneritis in terram, quam dabo vobis,
kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,

wlc: וְהָיָה בַּאֲכָלְכֶם מִלֶּחֶם הָאָרֶץ תָּרִימוּ תְרוּמָה לַיהוָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν ἔσθητε ὑμεῖς ἀπὸ τῶν ἄρτων τῆς γῆς, ἀφελεῖτε ἀφαίρεμα ἀφόρισμα Τυρίῳ·
vulg: et comederitis de panibus regionis illius separabitis primitias Domino
clem: et comederitis de panibus regionis illius, separabitis primitias Domino
kjv: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the Lord.

wlc: רֵאשִׁית עֲרִסֹתֵכֶם חַלָּה תָּרִימוּ תְרוּמָה כִּתְרוּמַת גֹּרֶן כֵּן תָּרִימוּ אֹתָהּ ׃
lxx: ἀπαρχὴν φυράματος ὑμῶν ἄρτον ἀφαίρεμα ἀφοριεῖτε αὐτό· ὡς ἀφαίρεμα ἀπὸ ἅλω, οὕτως ἀφελεῖτε αὐτόν,
vulg: de cibis vestris sicut de areis primitias separatis
clem: de cibis vestris. Sicut de areis primitias separatis,
kjv: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.

wlc: מֵרֵאשִׁית עֲרִסֹתֵיכֶם תִּתְּנוּ לַיהוָה תְּרוּמָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם ׃ ס
lxx: ἀπαρχὴν φυράματος ὑμῶν· καὶ δώσετε Τυρίῳ ἀφαίρεμα εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν.
vulg: ita et de pulmentis dabitis primitiva Domino
clem: ita et de pulmentis dabitis primitiva Domino.
kjv: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the Lord an heave offering in your generations.

wlc: וְכִי תִשְׁגּוּ וְלֹא תַעֲשׂוּ אֵת כָּל־הַמִּצְוֹת הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה ׃
lxx: Ὃταν δὲ διαμάρτητε καὶ μὴ ποιήσητε πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς ταύτας ἃς ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν,
vulg: quod si per ignorantiam praeterieritis quicquam horum quae locutus est Dominus ad Mosen
clem: Quod si per ignorantiam prterieritis quidquam horum, qu locutus est Dominus ad Moysen,
kjv: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the Lord hath spoken unto Moses,

wlc: אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה מִן־הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה וָהָלְאָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם ׃
lxx: καθὰ συνέταξενύριος Κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν χειρὶ (??) ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ἧς συνέταξεν κύριος πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐπέεἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν·
vulg: et mandavit per eum ad vos a die qua coepit iubere et ultra
clem: et mandavit per eum ad vos, a die qua cpit jubere et ultra,
kjv: Even all that the Lord hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the Lord commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;

wlc: וְהָיָה אִם מֵעֵינֵי הָעֵדָה נֶעֶשְׂתָה לִשְׁגָגָה וְעָשׂוּ כָל־הָעֵדָה פַּר בֶּן־בָּקָר אֶחָד לְעֹלָה לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהוָה וּמִנְחָתוֹ וְנִסְכּוֹ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וּשְׂעִיר־עִזִּים אֶחָד לְחַטָּת ׃
lxx: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν ἐξ ὀφθαλμῶν τῆς συναγωγῆς γενηθῇ ἀκουσίως, καὶ ποιήσῃ πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ μόσχον ἕνα ἐκ βοῶν ἄμωμον εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας κυρίῳ, καὶ θυσίαν τούτου καὶ σπονδὴν αὐτοῦ κατὰ τὴν σύνταξιν, καὶ χίμαρον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἕνα περὶ ἁμαρτίας.
vulg: oblitaque fuerit facere multitudo offeret vitulum de armento holocaustum in odorem suavissimum Domino et sacrificium eius ac liba ut caerimoniae postulant hircumque pro peccato
clem: oblitaque fuerit facere multitudo: offeret vitulum de armento, holocaustum in odorem suavissimum Domino, et sacrificum ejus ac liba, ut cremoni postulant, hircumque pro peccato:
kjv: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the Lord, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.

wlc: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן עַל־כָּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִסְלַח לָהֶם כִּי־שְׁגָגָה הִוא וְהֵם הֵבִיאוּ אֶת־קָרְבָּנָם אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָה וְחַטָּאתָם לִפְנֵי יְהוָה עַל־שִׁגְגָתָם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐξιλάσεται περὶ αὐτοῦ ὁ ἱερεύς, περὶ πάσης συναγωγῆς υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἀφεθήσεται αὐτοῖς· ὅτι ἀκούσιόν ἐστιν· καὶ αὐτοὶ ἤνεγκαν τὸ δῶρον αὐτῶν κάρπωμα Κυρίῳ περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν ἔναντι κυρίου περὶ τῶν ἀκουσίων αὐτῶν.
vulg: et rogabit sacerdos pro omni multitudine filiorum Israhel et dimittetur eis quoniam non sponte peccaverunt nihilominus offerentes incensum Domino pro se et pro peccato atque errore suo
clem: et rogabit sacerdos pro omni multitudine filiorum Isral, et dimittetur eis, quoniam non sponte peccaverunt, nihilominus offerentes incensum Domino pro se et pro peccato atque errore suo:
kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord, and their sin offering before the Lord, for their ignorance:

wlc: וְנִסְלַח לְכָל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם כִּי לְכָל־הָעָם בִּשְׁגָגָה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἀφεθήσεται κατὰ πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ καὶ τῷ π προσηλύτῳ τῷ προσκειμένῳ πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ὅτι παντὶ τῷ λαῷ ἀκούσιον.
vulg: et dimittetur universae plebi filiorum Israhel et advenis qui peregrinantur inter vos quoniam culpa est omnis populi per ignorantiam
clem: et dimittetur univers plebi filiorum Isral, et advenis qui peregrinantur inter eos: quoniam culpa est omnis populi per ignorantiam.
kjv: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.

wlc: וְאִם־נֶפֶשׁ אַחַת תֶּחֱטָא בִשְׁגָגָה וְהִקְרִיבָה עֵז בַּת־שְׁנָתָהּ לְחַטָּאת ׃
lxx: ἐὰν δὲ ψυχὴ μία ἁμάρτῃ ἀκουσίως, προσάξει αἶγα μίαν ἐνιαυσίαν περὶ ἁμαρτίας·
vulg: quod si anima una nesciens peccaverit offeret capram anniculam pro peccato suo
clem: Quod si anima una nesciens peccaverit, offeret capram anniculam pro peccato suo:
kjv: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.

wlc: וְכִפֶּר הַכֹּהֵן עַל־הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַשֹּׁגֶגֶת בְּחֶטְאָה בִשְׁגָגָה לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו וְנִסְלַח לוֹ ׃
lxx: κία ἐξιλάσεται ὁ ἱερεὺς περὶ τῆς ψυχῆς τῆς ἀκουσιασθείσης καὶ ἁμαρτούσης ἀκουσίως ἔναντι κυρίου, ἐξιλάσασθ αὐτοῦ.
vulg: et deprecabitur pro ea sacerdos quod inscia peccaverit coram Domino inpetrabitque ei veniam et dimittetur illi
clem: et deprecabitur pro ea sacerdos, quod inscia peccaverit coram Domino: impetrabitque ei veniam, et dimittetur illi.
kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the Lord, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.

wlc: הָאֶזְרָח בִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלַגֵּר הַגָּר בְּתוֹכָם תּוֹרָה אַחַת יִהְיֶה לָכֶם לָעֹשֶׂה בִּשְׁגָגָה ׃
lxx: τῷ ἐνχωρίῳ ἐνχωρίῳ ἐν υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ καὶ τῷ κειμένῳ ἐν αὐτοῖς, νόμος εἷς ἔσται αὐτοῖς, ὃς ἂν ποιήση ἀκουσίως.
vulg: tam indigenis quam advenis una lex erit omnium qui peccaverint ignorantes
clem: Tam indigenis quam advenis una lex erit omnium, qui peccaverint ignorantes.
kjv: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.

wlc: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂה בְּיָד רָמָה מִן־הָאֶזְרָח וּמִן־הַגֵּר אֶת־יְהוָה הוּא מְגַדֵּף וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִקֶּרֶב עַמָּהּ ׃
lxx: καὶ ψυχὴ ἥτις ποιήσει ἐν χειρὶ ὑπερηφανίας ἀπὸ τῶν αὐτοχθόνων ἢ ἀπὸ τῶν προσηλύτων, τόν θεὸν οὗτος παροξύνει· ἐξολεθρευθήσεται ἡ ψυχὴ ἐκείνη ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτῆς.
vulg: anima vero quae per superbiam aliquid commiserit sive civis sit ille sive peregrinus quoniam adversum Dominum rebellis fuit peribit de populo suo
clem: Anima vero, qu per superbiam aliquid commiserit, sive civis sit ille, sive peregrinus (quoniam adversus Dominum rebellis fuit), peribit de populo suo:
kjv: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the Lord; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

wlc: כִּי דְבַר־יְהוָה בָּזָה וְאֶת־מִצְוָתוֹ הֵפַר הִכָּרֵת תִּכָּרֵת הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא עֲוֹנָה בָהּ ׃ פ
lxx: ὅτι τὰ ῥήματα κυρίου ἐφαύλισεν καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ διεσκέδασεν· ἐκτρίψει ἐκτριβήσεται ἡ ψυχὴ ἐκείνη, ἡ ἁμαρτία αὐτῆς ἐν αὐτῇ.
vulg: verbum enim Domini contempsit et praeceptum illius fecit irritum idcirco delebitur et portabit iniquitatem suam
clem: verbum enim Domini contempsit, et prceptum illius fecit irritum: idcirco delebitur, et portabit iniquitatem suam.
kjv: Because he hath despised the word of the Lord, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.

wlc: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיִּמְצְאוּ אִישׁ מְקֹשֵׁשׁ עֵצִים בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת ׃
lxx: Καὶ ἦσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, καὶ εὗρον ἄνδρα συλλέγοντα ξύλα τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων.
vulg: factum est autem cum essent filii Israhel in solitudine et invenissent hominem colligentem ligna in die sabbati
clem: Factum est autem, cum essent filii Isral in solitudine, et invenissent hominem colligentem ligna in die sabbati,
kjv: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.

wlc: וַיַּקְרִיבוּ אֹתוֹ הַמֹּצְאִים אֹתוֹ מְקֹשֵׁשׁ עֵצִים אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וְאֶל־אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל כָּל־הָעֵדָה ׃
lxx: καὶ π προσήγαγον αὐτὸν οἱ εὑρόντες συλλέγοντα ξύλα τῇ ἡμέρα τῶν σαββάτων πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ἀαρὼν καὶ πρὸς πᾶσαν συναγωγὴν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: obtulerunt eum Mosi et Aaron et universae multitudini
clem: obtulerunt eum Moysi et Aaron et univers multitudini.
kjv: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.

wlc: וַיַּנִּיחוּ אֹתוֹ בַּמִּשְׁמָר כִּי לֹא פֹרַשׁ מַה־יֵּעָשֶׂה לוֹ ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἀπέθεντο αὐτὸν εἰς φυλακήν, οὐ γὰρ συνέκριναν τί ποιήσωσιν αὐτόν.
vulg: qui recluserunt eum in carcerem nescientes quid super eo facere deberent
clem: Qui recluserunt eum in carcerem, nescientes quid super eo facere deberent.
kjv: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה מוֹת יוּמַת הָאִישׁ רָגוֹם אֹתוֹ בָאֲבָנִים כָּל־הָעֵדָה מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων Θανάτῳ θανατούσθω ὁ ἄνθρωπος· λιθοβολήσατε αὐτὸν λίθοις πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγή.
vulg: dixitque Dominus ad Mosen morte moriatur homo iste obruat eum lapidibus omnis turba extra castra
clem: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen: Morte moriatur homo iste: obruat eum lapidibus omnis turba extra castra.
kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.

wlc: וַיֹּצִיאוּ אֹתוֹ כָּל־הָעֵדָה אֶל־מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה וַיִּרְגְּמוּ אֹתוֹ בָּאֲבָנִים וַיָּמֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־מֹשֶׁה ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἐξήγαγον αὐτὸν πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς· καὶ ἐλιθοβόλησεν αὐτὸν πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ λίθοις ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς, καθὰ συνέταξεν Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.
vulg: cumque eduxissent eum foras obruerunt lapidibus et mortuus est sicut praeceperat Dominus
clem: Cumque eduxissent eum foras, obruerunt lapidibus, et mortuus est, sicut prceperat Dominus.
kjv: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the Lord commanded Moses.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων
vulg: dixit quoque Dominus ad Mosen
clem: Dixit quoque Dominus ad Moysen:
kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

wlc: דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם וְעָשׂוּ לָהֶם צִיצִת עַל־כַּנְפֵי בִגְדֵיהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם וְנָתְנוּ עַל־צִיצִת הַכָּנָף פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת ׃
lxx: Λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτούς, καὶ ποιησάτωσαν ἑαυτοῖς κράσπεδα ἐπὶ τὰ πτερύγια τῶν ἱματίων αὐτῶν εἰς τὰς γενεὰς αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐπιθήσετε ἐπὶ τὰ κράσπεδα τῶν πτερυγίων κλῶσμα ὑακίνθινον.
vulg: loquere filiis Israhel et dices ad eos ut faciant sibi fimbrias per angulos palliorum ponentes in eis vittas hyacinthinas
clem: Loquere filiis Isral, et dices ad eos ut faciant sibi fimbrias per angulos palliorum, ponentes in eis vittas hyacinthinas:
kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:

wlc: וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְצִיצִת וּרְאִיתֶם אֹתוֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹת יְהוָה וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וְלֹא־תָתֻרוּ אַחֲרֵי לְבַבְכֶם וְאַחֲרֵי עֵינֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּם זֹנִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν ἐν τοῖς κρασπέδοις, καὶ ὄψεσθε αὐτά, καὶ μνησθήσεσθε πασῶν τῶν ἐντολῶν Κυρίου καὶ ποιήσετε αὐτάς, καὶ οὐ διακατα στραφήσεσθε ὀπίσω τῶν διανοιων ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν ἐν οἷς ἐκπορνεύετε ὀπίσω αὐτῶν·
vulg: quas cum viderint recordentur omnium mandatorum Domini nec sequantur cogitationes suas et oculos per res varias fornicantes
clem: quas cum viderint, recordentur omnium mandatorum Domini, nec sequantur cogitationes suas et oculos per res varias fornicantes,
kjv: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the Lord, and do them ; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:

wlc: לְמַעַן תִּזְכְּרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹתָי וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים לֵאלֹהֵיכֶם ׃
lxx: ὅπως ἂν μνησθῆτε καὶ ποιήσητε πάσας τὰς ἐντολάς μου, καὶ ἔσεσθε ἅγιοι τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν.
vulg: sed magis memores praeceptorum Domini faciant ea sintque sancti Deo suo
clem: sed magis memores prceptorum Domini faciant ea, sintque sancti Deo suo.
kjv: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.

wlc: אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם ׃ פ
lxx: ἐγὼ Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν, ὁ ἐξαγαγὼν ὑμᾶς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου εἶναι ὑμῶν θεός· ἐγὼ Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν.
vulg: ego Dominus Deus vester qui eduxi vos de terra Aegypti ut essem vester Deus
clem: Ego Dominus Deus vester, qui eduxi vos de terra gypti, ut essem Deus vester.
kjv: I am the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord your God.

wlc: וַיִּקַּח קֹרַח בֶּן־יִצְהָר בֶּן־קְהָת בֶּן־לֵוִי וְדָתָן וַאֲבִירָם בְּנֵי אֱלִיאָב וְאוֹן בֶּן־פֶּלֶת בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵן ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Κόρε υἱὸς Ἰσσαὰρ υἱοῦ καάθ υἱοῦ Λευεί, καὶ Δαθὰν καὶ Ἀβειρὼν υἱοὶ Ἐλιάβ, καὶ Αὒν υἱὸς Φάλεθ υἱοῦ Ῥουβήν·
vulg: ecce autem Core filius Isaar filii Caath filii Levi et Dathan atque Abiram filii Heliab Hon quoque filius Pheleth de filiis Ruben
clem: Ecce autem Core filius Isaar, filii Caath, filii Levi, et Dathan atque Abiron filii Eliab, Hon quoque filius Pheleth de filiis Ruben,
kjv: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:

wlc: וַיָּקֻמוּ לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה וַאֲנָשִׁים מִבְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל חֲמִשִּׁים וּמָאתָיִם נְשִׂיאֵי עֵדָה קְרִאֵי מוֹעֵד אַנְשֵׁי־שֵׁם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀνέστησαν ἔναντι Μωυσῆ, καὶ ἄνδρες τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ πεντήκοντα καὶ διακόσιοι, ἀρχηγοὶ συναγωγῆς, σύνκλητοι βουλῆς καὶ ἄνδρες ὀνομαστοί·
vulg: surrexerunt contra Mosen aliique filiorum Israhel ducenti quinquaginta viri proceres synagogae et qui tempore concilii per nomina vocabantur
clem: surrexerunt contra Moysen, aliique filiorum Isral ducenti quinquaginta viri proceres synagog, et qui tempore concilii per nomina vocabantur.
kjv: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:

wlc: וַיִּקָּהֲלוּ עַל־מֹשֶׁה וְעַל־אַהֲרֹן וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵהֶם רַב־לָכֶם כִּי כָל־הָעֵדָה כֻּלָּם קְדֹשִׁים וּבְתוֹכָם יְהוָה וּמַדּוּעַ תִּתְנַשְּׂאוּ עַל־קְהַל יְהוָה ׃
lxx: συνέστησαν ὀπίσω Μωυσῆ καὶ Ἀαρὼν καὶ εἶπαν Ἐχέτω ὑμῖν, ὅτι πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ πάντες ἅγιοι, καὶ ἐν αὐτοῖς Κύριος· καὶ διὰ τί κατανίστασθε ἐπὶ τὴν συναγωγὴν Κύρου;
vulg: cumque stetissent adversum Mosen et Aaron dixerunt sufficiat vobis quia omnis multitudo sanctorum est et in ipsis est Dominus cur elevamini super populum Domini
clem: Cumque stetissent adversum Moysen et Aaron, dixerunt: Sufficiat vobis, quia omnis multitudo sanctorum est, et in ipsis est Dominus: cur elevamini super populum Domini?
kjv: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the Lord?

wlc: וַיִּשְׁמַע מֹשֶׁה וַיִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנָיו ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀκούσας Μωυσῆς ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον,
vulg: quod cum audisset Moses cecidit pronus in faciem
clem: Quod cum audisset Moyses, cecidit pronus in faciem:
kjv: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:

wlc: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל־קֹרַח וְאֶל־כָּל־עֲדָתוֹ לֵאמֹר בֹּקֶר וְיֹדַע יְהוָה אֶת־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וְאֶת־הַקָּדוֹשׁ וְהִקְרִיב אֵלָיו וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר־בּוֹ יַקְרִיב אֵלָיו ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς κέ καὶ πρὸς πᾶσαν αὐτοῦ τὴν συναγωγὴν λέγων Ἐπέσκεπται καὶ ἔγνω ὁ θεὸς τοὺς ὄντας αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἁγίους, καὶ π ροσηγάγετο πρὸς ἑαυτόν, καὶ οὓς ἐξελέξατο ἑαυτῷ π ροσηγάγετο πρὸς ἑαυτόν.
vulg: locutusque ad Core et ad omnem multitudinem mane inquit notum faciet Dominus qui ad se pertineant et sanctos adplicabit sibi et quos elegerit adpropinquabunt ei
clem: locutusque ad Core et ad omnem multitudinem: Mane, inquit, notum faciet Dominus qui ad se pertineant, et sanctos applicabit sibi: et quos elegerit, appropinquabunt ei.
kjv: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the Lord will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.

wlc: זֹאת עֲשׂוּ קְחוּ־לָכֶם מַחְתּוֹת קֹרַח וְכָל־עֲדָתוֹ ׃
lxx: τοῦτο ποιήσατε· λάβετε ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς πυρεῖα, Κόρε καὶ πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ αὐτοῦ,
vulg: hoc igitur facite tollat unusquisque turibula sua tu Core et omne concilium tuum
clem: Hoc igitur facite: tollat unusquisque thuribula sua, tu Core, et omne concilium tuum:
kjv: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;

wlc: וּתְנוּ בָהֵן אֵשׁ וְשִׂימוּ עֲלֵיהֶן קְטֹרֶת לִפְנֵי יְהוָה מָחָר וְהָיָה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַר יְהוָה הוּא הַקָּדוֹשׁ רַב־לָכֶם בְּנֵי לֵוִי ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπίθετε ἐπ’ αὐτὰ πῦρ, καὶ ἐπίθετε ἐπ’ αὐτὰ θυμίαμα ἔναντι κυρίου αὔριον· καὶ ἱστᾶι ὁ ἀνὴρ ὃν ἐκλέγεται κύριος, οὗτος ἅγιος· ἱκανούσθω ὑμῖν, υἱοὶ Λευεί.
vulg: et hausto cras igne ponite desuper thymiama coram Domino et quemcumque elegerit ipse erit sanctus multum erigimini filii Levi
clem: et hausto cras igne, ponite desuper thymiama coram Domino: et quemcumque elegerit, ipse erit sanctus: multum erigimini filii Levi.
kjv: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the Lord to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the Lord doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.

wlc: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל־קֹרַח שִׁמְעוּ־נָא בְּנֵי לֵוִי ׃
lxx: καὶ εἶπεν Μωυσῆς πρὸς κόρε Εἰσακούσατέ μου, υἱοὶ Λευεί.
vulg: dixitque rursum ad Core audite filii Levi
clem: Dixitque rursum ad Core: Audite, filii Levi:
kjv: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:

wlc: הַמְעַט מִכֶּם כִּי־הִבְדִּיל אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶתְכֶם מֵעֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַקְרִיב אֶתְכֶם אֵלָיו לַעֲבֹד אֶת־עֲבֹדַת מִשְׁכַּן יְהוָה וְלַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי הָעֵדָה לְשָׁרְתָם ׃
lxx: μὴ μικρόν ἐστιν τοῦτο ὑμῖν ὅτι διέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς Ἰσραὴλ ὑμᾶς ἐκ συναγωγῆς Ἰσραήλ, καὶ προσηγάγετο ὑμᾶς πρὸς ἑαυτὸν λειτουργεῖν τὰς λειτουργίας τῆς σκηνῆς Κυρίου καὶ παρίστασθαι ἔναντι τῆς σκηνῆς λατρεύειν αὐτοῖς,
vulg: num parum vobis est quod separavit vos Deus Israhel ab omni populo et iunxit sibi ut serviretis ei in cultu tabernaculi et staretis coram frequentia populi et ministraretis ei
clem: num parum vobis est quod separavit vos Deus Isral ab omni populo, et junxit sibi, ut serviretis ei in cultu tabernaculi, et staretis coram frequentia populi, et ministraretis ei?
kjv: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the Lord, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?

wlc: וַיַּקְרֵב אֹתְךָ וְאֶת־כָּל־אַחֶיךָ בְנֵי־לֵוִי אִתָּךְ וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּם גַּם־כְּהֻנָּה ׃
lxx: καὶ προσηγάγετό σε καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου υἱοὺς Λευεὶ μετὰ σοῦ ; καὶ ζητεῖτε καὶ ἱερατεύειν ;
